overview: Infertility is a disease of the male or female reproductive system defined by the failure to achieve a pregnancy after 12 months or more of regular unprotected sexual intercourse.
diagnosis: In-vitro fertilization (IVF) and other types of medically assisted reproduction
treatment: In-vitro fertilization (IVF) and other types of medically assisted reproduction
transmission: Not applicable, as infertility is not a transmissible disease
risk_factors: Lifestyle factors such as smoking, excessive alcohol intake, and obesity
Exposure to environmental pollutants and toxins
Hormonal disorders, testicular failure, and abnormal sperm function and quality
